assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Where the assistant runs: "off", "server" (the chat server) or "onDevice" (in Chrome, with Gemini Nano). When set, admins can't change it in the popup.

chatServerUrl.title: Chat server URL
chatServerUrl.description: Base URL of the Okta Max chat server, e.g. https://oktamax.example.com. An empty string turns the assistant off. When set, admins can't change it in the popup.
